contractRule: GM Mode exposes only 1YR or 3YR. A player whose real team control expires during the 2026-2028 game window is 1YR; control beyond the window is 3YR.
salaryRule: Use current contract average annual value (APY), not NFL cap hit.
sourceNotes: Population is the current manually audited NFL Wheel player universe; coaches are excluded.
Contract history and the 2027 free-agent snapshot provide the bulk baseline. High-impact and post-baseline contracts are reconciled to current OverTheCap contract terms as of 2026-10-05.
No fallback salary is permitted. Every curated player identity must have an explicit resolved contract row before this artifact passes coverage.
